verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents a public, OpenAI-compatible hosted endpoint that official OpenAI clients can call by setting `base_url` (docs-4). It also documents extensive programmatic SDK APIs for streaming generation, chat, tool calling, structured output, STT/TTS, VLM and model downloads (docs-1, 2, 8, 19, 21, 28, 30), plus `wally account` commands for usage and identity (docs-11). Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths return 404), detailed REST endpoint reference beyond the OpenAI-compatibility claim, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the hosted API works as documented.
